name: Homarr v2
description: Homarr v2 dashboard. This is a new app, separate from Homarr v1. The default SQLite database moves by copying /appdata and keeping the same SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY. An external PostgreSQL database is not in /appdata. Stop v1, back up that database, then set the same DB_DIALECT and DB_URL and leave v1 stopped while v2 migrates it. MySQL is no longer supported; convert existing MySQL data to SQLite before starting v2. Not compatible with legacy Homarr (v0.x) data without migration.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  big-bear-homarr-v2:
    container_name: big-bear-homarr-v2
    image: ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr:v2.0.0@sha256:3eeef80bfc58f6588844e9405da47550f681006d3019005a34f9388b5c00eb73
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/appdata:/appdata
    environment:
      # CasaOS writes the install-form value onto this line. A ${SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY} placeholder is left unset.
      - SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY=
      # ZimaOS loads this file through CasaOS. An unset ${VAR:-default} is treated as
      # the non-empty placeholder $VAR, then expanded to an empty string. An empty
      # DB_DIALECT overrides the image default and Homarr runs
      # /app/db/migrations/migrate.cjs, which is not in the image. These literals
      # stay put. Set DB_DIALECT to postgresql and DB_URL to that database to migrate one.
      - DB_DIALECT=sqlite
      - DB_URL=/appdata/db/db.sqlite
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:7575"
